summary: Selects the CRT heap implementation type at runtime. Fast path: returns 1 when GetVersionExA reports platform 2 with major version 5 or later. Otherwise reads the __MSVCRT_HEAP_SELECT environment variable into a 4240-byte buffer, uppercases it, and when it matches __GLOBAL_HEAP_SELECTED compares it against the executable module filename before choosing a heap-selection string. Splits the chosen value at the comma delimiter (0x2C), terminates at any semicolon, and dispatches through CallWrapperWith0, accepting results 1, 2 or 3. Any failed path falls back to PEImageBaseAddressDetection on a 4-byte buffer and returns 3 when the PE linker major version is below 6, else 1.

local_names.Buffer: 4240-byte heap-select environment value, uppercased in place
local_names.VersionInformation: OSVERSIONINFOA struct sized 148 used by GetVersionExA
local_names.v3: chosen heap-selection string (env value or module-match result)
local_names.v6: pointer just past the comma delimiter
local_names.v8: walker that replaces semicolons with string terminators
local_names.v12: 4-byte buffer written by PEImageBaseAddressDetection for linker-version fallback

operations.description: Sets VersionInformation.dwOSVersionInfoSize to 148 and calls GetVersionExA
Guard: returns 1 early when GetVersionExA succeeded, dwPlatformId equals 2 and dwMajorVersion is >= 5
Calls GetEnvironmentVariableA for __MSVCRT_HEAP_SELECT into Buffer with capacity 0x1090 (4240); a zero return skips to the fallback label
Walks Buffer and uppercases any lowercase ASCII letters in place
Compares Buffer against __GLOBAL_HEAP_SELECTED via sub_588640 with length 22
On a match, gets the module filename via GetModuleFileNameA (capacity 0x104, 260) and uppercases it
When the module path matched, calls sub_587C20(Buffer, Filename) to obtain the effective heap-selection string; otherwise v3 stays Buffer
Guard: a null v3 jumps to the fallback label
Calls sub_589DB0(v3, 0x2C) to locate the comma delimiter in the selection string; null result jumps to the fallback label
From the byte after the comma, walks forward replacing every semicolon (59) with a string terminator
Dispatches the parsed value through CallWrapperWith0(v7, 0, 10); accepted results are 1, 2 or 3
Guard: result not equal to 2, 3 or 1 falls through to the fallback label
Fallback path: calls PEImageBaseAddressDetection on the 4-byte v12 buffer

Computes the fallback result as 3 when the byte written to the PE-header globals (0xFF00000000005370 and friends, read at 0xFF00000000005371/0xFF00000000005374) is below 6, else 1, returned as 3 - (v12[0] < 6)
Returns result when it is one of 1, 2 or 3; otherwise returns the computed fallback value
Compiler-generated stack probing (__alloca_probe) for the large local buffers; invoked by sub_59325D

unresolved: The PE-header globals 0xFF00000000005370 (written), 0xFF00000000005371 and 0xFF00000000005374 (read) are recorded in packet facts but do not appear in the raw decompiled source; the byte-vs-major-version mapping is DERIVED and unproven
CallWrapperWith0 semantics (which integer selects which heap implementation) are unknown
sub_588640, sub_587C20, sub_589DB0 and PEImageBaseAddressDetection are unnamed callees
